in_marathi.name: Chitrali
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chitrali हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'chitra' which means 'picture', 'Chitrali' could be a name for a beautiful, artistic, or imaginative girl. In Hindu mythology, Chitrali can also be considered a form of the goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, music, and art.
